title: Ben Horowitz on How a16z Was Built
summary:

Andries and Horowitz, where every market has a platform that's appropriate to
that market and an investing team that is focused on that market. And I think
that that's the future venture capital. We're in this phase where it's such a
profound change that anything you do will work, at least for a while.

thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that the future of venture capital involves organizing firms as collections of specialized teams focused on specific markets like AI, crypto, and games, rather than generalist structures. He contends that this product-first approach, where platforms are appropriate to each market, allows firms to scale effectively without creating the demand-supply imbalances that public markets or aggressive capital deployment can cause.
